readme:
# RDT-1B 统一动作槽与有效维度

## 1. 问题

把不同机器人的局部动作放进统一语义槽，并屏蔽不存在的执行维度。

提取RDT统一动作空间与采样输出mask；使用可配置小槽表，不复制完整128维schema或12亿参数Transformer。

## 2. 核心公式

$$
U_{bht}=\sum_j A_{bhj}\,\mathbf1[t=s_j],\quad M_t=\mathbf1[t\in\{s_j\}],\quad A^{exec}=\hat U\odot M.
$$

## 3. 公式到代码

- `pack_actions(local: Tensor, slots: list, width: int) -> tuple`
- `mask_actions(actions: Tensor, valid: Tensor) -> Tensor`

统一表示中的空槽不能挤压掉：同一槽始终对应相同物理量。掩码既区分缺失维度，也在执行前清除去噪器的无效输出；源码训练MSE不等于有效维度mask损失，因此本题不替换其训练目标。

## 4. 本题约定

local为(B,H,D)，slots为长度D的Python整数list，每个槽唯一且位于[0,width)；返回(B,H,width)浮点动作及(width,)布尔mask。mask_actions接收同形动作及(width,)mask。未使用槽必须为0，动作梯度保留。

校验辅助函数已提供。浮点输入为有限 CPU float32/float64，不修改输入；非法形状、类型、范围或掩码必须抛出 `ValueError`。

## 5. 交互图与确定性实验

将三维动作映射到六维统一空间，训练一个六维常数预测器；未使用槽初始值为9，通过执行mask保证这些维度始终为零。

可视化由 `viz/gen.py` 生成；T3 将你的函数传入同一实验并记录真实指标。这是小规模确定性教学实验，不是机器人基准成绩。

## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 来源与延伸

- [RDT-1B: a Diffusion Foundation Model for Bimanual Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.07864) — Physically interpretable unified action space; official RDTRunner.conditional_sample final action mask
- [Verified source](https://rdt-robotics.github.io/rdt-robotics/)
- [Verified source](https://github.com/thu-ml/RoboticsDiffusionTransformer/blob/main/models/rdt_runner.py)

核验日期：2026-10-28。扩展到完整论文系统还需要本题范围中明确省略的模型、数据和环境。
notes:
# RDT-1B: 题解与易错点

统一表示中的空槽不能挤压掉：同一槽始终对应相同物理量。掩码既区分缺失维度，也在执行前清除去噪器的无效输出；源码训练MSE不等于有效维度mask损失，因此本题不替换其训练目标。

使用one-hot槽矩阵乘法可保留局部动作梯度。重复槽会让物理含义混合，应直接拒绝。有效值本身为0仍然是存在的动作维度。

## 测试捕获的错误

- The packing matrix uses local indices instead of semantic slots.
- Execution fails to mask absent action coordinates.

## 实验范围

提取RDT统一动作空间与采样输出mask；使用可配置小槽表，不复制完整128维schema或12亿参数Transformer。

## 可重复实验记录

3个局部坐标映射至6维统一动作；初值9，100步梯度下降(lr=0.5)。要求有效动作误差<初始1e-10且未用坐标严格为零。

判题固定seed=42。计算采用CPU float64、显式输入，涉及优化时使用普通梯度更新；不下载数据集或模型权重。原生PyTorch与真实Pyodide/NumPy-WASM执行同一套T0–T3测试。阈值针对本教学实验。

en.title: RDT-1B Unified Action Slots and Valid Dimensions
en.readme:
# RDT-1B Unified Action Slots and Valid Dimensions

## 1. Exercise goal

Place embodiment-specific actions in unified semantic slots and mask absent execution dimensions.

Isolate unified action placement and final sampling masks using a configurable small slot map, not the complete 128D schema or 1.2B Transformer.

## 2. Core equations

$$
U_{bht}=\sum_j A_{bhj}\,\mathbf1[t=s_j],\quad M_t=\mathbf1[t\in\{s_j\}],\quad A^{exec}=\hat U\odot M.
$$

## 3. From equations to code

- `pack_actions(local: Tensor, slots: list, width: int) -> tuple`
- `mask_actions(actions: Tensor, valid: Tensor) -> Tensor`

Do not compact empty slots: each slot retains its physical meaning. The mask distinguishes absent coordinates and clears invalid denoiser outputs before execution. The released training MSE is not a valid-coordinate masked loss, so this exercise does not substitute that objective.

## 4. Contract and boundaries

Local actions are (B,H,D); slots is a Python list of D distinct integers in [0,width). Return floating (B,H,width) actions and bool (width,) validity. mask_actions accepts a sequence and a (width,) bool mask. Unused slots are zero; preserve action gradients.

Validation helpers are provided. All floating inputs are finite CPU float32/float64; do not mutate inputs. Invalid shape, dtype, range or mask arguments raise `ValueError`.

## 5. Deterministic experiment and visualization

Map three action coordinates into six unified slots and train a six-coordinate constant predictor; unused slots start at nine and the execution mask must always suppress them.

The visualization is generated by `viz/gen.py`; T3 runs the same experiment with your functions and records its actual metrics. These are small deterministic teaching results, not a robot benchmark.

## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Sources and extensions

- [RDT-1B: a Diffusion Foundation Model for Bimanual Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.07864) — Physically interpretable unified action space; official RDTRunner.conditional_sample final action mask
- [Verified source](https://rdt-robotics.github.io/rdt-robotics/)
- [Verified source](https://github.com/thu-ml/RoboticsDiffusionTransformer/blob/main/models/rdt_runner.py)

Verified 2026-10-28. Extending this operator to the full paper requires the omitted model, data and environment described in the scope above.
en.notes:
# RDT-1B: Solution notes

Do not compact empty slots: each slot retains its physical meaning. The mask distinguishes absent coordinates and clears invalid denoiser outputs before execution. The released training MSE is not a valid-coordinate masked loss, so this exercise does not substitute that objective.

A one-hot slot matrix preserves gradients to local actions. Reject duplicate slots rather than mixing physical meanings. A valid action equal to zero still has a present dimension.

## Mistakes caught by the tests

- The packing matrix uses local indices instead of semantic slots.
- Execution fails to mask absent action coordinates.

## Experimental scope

Isolate unified action placement and final sampling masks using a configurable small slot map, not the complete 128D schema or 1.2B Transformer.

## Reproducible protocol

Map three local coordinates into six unified coordinates; initialize predictions at nine and take 100 gradient steps at lr .5. Require loss below 1e-10 of initial loss and exactly zero unused execution coordinates.

The judge fixes seed 42. All calculations use CPU float64, explicit inputs and plain gradient updates where applicable; no datasets or model weights are downloaded. Native PyTorch and actual Pyodide/NumPy-WASM run the same T0–T3 suite. Thresholds refer to this teaching adaptation.
